findings.text: tests/test_a_landing_checks_what_it_left.py:186 and tests/test_rollback_asks_head.py:115 are edited although neither lies in the four paths the dispatch fenced, so the diff writes files the node had no grant for; the fragment asserts 'the scope was extended' but no grant is recorded anywhere the coordinator can check, and the worker contract requires a scope change to be requested rather than taken, so the coordinator should confirm an extension was actually granted before promotion.

commit afb0bd244 also reformats five pre-existing unformatted constructs at lines 1217, 1259, 1268, 1679, 2342 and 2363 so that ruff format --check reports the whole file clean, folding an unrelated formatting sweep into a fix commit; repo AGENTS.md requires a broad relint to land as its own style(lint) commit so a reviewer can see what the commit did.

_staging_names_a_held_index_lock re-implements the bounded 'wait out a held .git/index.lock' capability that reckon/crew/merge.py already owns at _index_lock_held:349 with its retry loop at merge.py:505-518, detecting the same condition by a message substring rather than the lock file's existence; no shared owner was extended, so the two bound-in-time waiters can drift apart.

item_verdicts.diff: read all six commits from 2ff02228 to 83274eee8; afb0bd244 adds the retry to promotion_scope.py, 5fe9c6549/fa191da41 update the two importing tests, and bf599536e/92f53cde1/83274eee8 are the fragment commits.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_landing_write_waits_out_a_held_index_lock.py with a brief-hold commit, a past-window refusal naming the lock, a no-lock first-attempt refusal, and a negative control; head-gate.log and negative-control.log record each of those outcomes.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to make the landing staging retry a staging failure naming a held index.lock, recording each retry on the run's landing record; reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2214 _stage_landing_writes does exactly that.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, commits afb0bd244..83274eee8, the focused gate 3/3 over three runs EXIT=0, the red negative control EXIT=1, and the base/head importing set with one environmental failure in both arms.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the dispatch declared four paths; the diff changes those four and additionally edits tests/test_a_landing_checks_what_it_left.py and tests/test_rollback_asks_head.py, which are not among them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_landing_write_waits_out_a_held_index_lock.py:143 asserts result['committed'] is True against the code's own return, which the negative control shows reddens when the retry at promotion_scope.py:2224 is removed, so the assertion is independent of any value the test handed in.
justifications.evidence: the done_when names tests/test_a_landing_write_waits_out_a_held_index_lock.py; head-gate.log records 3 passed EXIT=0, negative-control.log records 2 failed/1 passed EXIT=1, and baseline-suite.log/after-suite.log record the importing set at 1 failed/167 passed and 1 failed/170 passed.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2226 uses the module's existing _git and _append_landing_record helpers, and no added name carries a plan label, but commit afb0bd244 also reformats pre-existing unformatted lines at 1217-2363.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2214 _stage_landing_writes retries the staging git add on a failure whose message names index.lock for a bounded window and appends a stage_retry entry to the run's landing.json, which is what the goal asks for.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:2210 _staging_names_a_held_index_lock re-implements the bounded wait-out-a-held-index.lock capability that reckon/crew/merge.py:349 _index_lock_held and its retry loop at merge.py:511 already own, without extending it.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff touches six files while the dispatch fenced four; tests/test_a_landing_checks_what_it_left.py and tests/test_rollback_asks_head.py are edited outside the declared write paths.
